airspace.zh: 太魯閣國家公園全區適用內政部公告的「太魯閣國家公園區域內禁止事項」，禁止擅自在指定地區以外操作遙控機具（含空拍機）；實際飛行須事先向太魯閣國家公園管理處申請許可，違者可處罰鍰。另須遵守民航局遙控無人機規定，行前請用民航局「Drone Map」App 查詢空域。
airspace.en: The whole park is covered by the Ministry of the Interior's "Prohibited Acts within Taroko National Park", which bans operating remote-controlled craft (drones included) outside designated areas without authorisation; real flights need prior permission from Taroko National Park Headquarters, and violations are fined. Civil Aeronautics Administration drone rules also apply: check the airspace in the CAA "Drone Map" app first.

taroko_archway.zh: 太魯閣牌樓（東西橫貫公路牌樓）
taroko_archway.en: Taroko Archway (east entrance of the Central Cross-Island Highway)
taroko_archway.note: Archway built in 1960 at the eastern entrance of the highway; coordinates from the komoot highlight "East Entrance Archway, Taroko Gorge".

visitor_center.note: Park visitor centre on the terrace at the gorge mouth; coordinates listed by the Tourism Administration.

changchun_shrine.note: Shrine above Changchun Falls commemorating those who died building the highway.

shakadang_trailhead.note: Start of the trail along Shakadang Stream, first tributary of the Liwu River.

xipan_dam.zh: 立霧溪攔河壩（溪畔一帶）
xipan_dam.en: Dam and reservoir on the Liwu River (Xipan area)
xipan_dam.note: Reservoir reach of the Liwu River between Changchun Shrine and Buluowan; coordinates from the komoot highlight "Reservoir in Taroko National Park".

buluowan.note: Terrace with the Truku culture exhibits and the Shanyue suspension bridge; coordinates from the komoot highlight "Idas Trail (Taroko National Park)" on the terrace.

yanzikou.note: One of the narrowest stretches of the marble gorge; also the eastern end of the Zhuilu Old Road.

cimu_bridge.note: Highway bridge at the upstream end of the narrow gorge; western end of the Zhuilu Old Road.

tianxiang.note: River terrace at the confluence that forms the Liwu River; coordinates are those of Xiangde Temple at Tianxiang.

baiyang_trail.note: Trail in the forested valley just upstream of Tianxiang.

wenshan.note: Hot spring in the upper valley north of Tianxiang; the 1914 road from the gorge mouth reached this point.

liwu_mouth.note: Where the 55 km Liwu River enters the Pacific.

chongde.note: Truku settlement on the coast near the river mouth; coordinates of Chongde station as listed by the Tourism Administration.

qingshui_cliff.note: About 21 km of sea cliffs of marble and gneiss beneath Mount Qingshui (2,408 m).

dali_viewpoint.en: Viewpoint on the trail to Dali village
dali_viewpoint.note: Viewpoint at about 740 m on the way up to the Truku villages of Dali and Datong; komoot highlight "View of the Valley from Dali".

dayuling.note: Pass at 2,565 m on the Central Mountain Range; highest point of the Central Cross-Island Highway.

mountain_road.zh: 中橫公路山區路段（海拔約2430公尺）
mountain_road.en: Central Cross-Island Highway, mountain section (about 2,430 m)
mountain_road.note: Point on the highway between Dayuling and Tianxiang; komoot highlight "Taroko Gorge Highway".

wuling.note: Pass at 3,275 m near Hehuanshan; highest paved road in Taiwan.

hehuan_north_peak.note: Highest point of Hehuanshan (3,422 m), at the western edge of the park; coordinates as given for Hehuanshan on Wikipedia.

title.en: Old Roads, a Highway and a National Park

tagline.zh-Hant: 從1914年的警備道，到中橫通車與1986年成立國家公園
tagline.en: From the 1914 police road to the cross-island highway and the park of 1986

zh: 太魯閣口的這座牌樓，標示著中部橫貫公路的東端入口。
外來的道路，是怎麼一步步伸進這座峽谷的。
en: This archway at the gorge mouth marks the eastern entrance of the Central Cross-Island Highway.
How did roads from outside push, step by step, into this gorge?

zh: 牌樓建於1960年，為慶祝公路通車而立。
現為花蓮縣歷史建築，彩繪橫梁在2026年初完成修復。
en: It was built in 1960 to celebrate the opening of the highway.
Now a Hualien County historic building, it had its painted beam restored in early 2026.

zh: 峽谷原是太魯閣族人的家園。
1914年，日本當局沿立霧溪開鑿軍用與警備道路，深入內山。
en: The gorge was first of all the homeland of the Truku people.
In 1914 the Japanese authorities cut military and police roads along the Liwu River into the interior.

zh: 從燕子口到慈母橋，山壁高處有一條錐麓古道。
斷崖一段長約500公尺，路就鑿在岩壁上，僅容一人通行。
en: High on the walls between Yanzikou and Cimu Bridge runs the Zhuilu Old Road.
Its cliff section, about 500 m long, is cut into the rock face and fits one walker at a time.

zh: 1933年6月，合歡越嶺道路動工，隔年1月大致完工。
1935年全線開通，從花蓮經天祥、合歡山通往霧社。
en: In June 1933 work began on the Hehuan cross-ridge road; it was largely finished by January 1934.
The full line opened in 1935, linking Hualien with Wushe via Tianxiang and Hehuanshan.

zh: 1934年1月，越嶺道路的完工典禮在今天的天祥舉行。
這條路起初為軍事與警備而開，後來也成為採金道路。
en: In January 1934 the road's completion ceremony was held at what is now Tianxiang.
Opened for military and police use, the route later also served gold prospecting.

zh: 1937年，臺灣總督府指定次高太魯閣國立公園。
範圍約27萬公頃，隨著日治結束而廢止。
en: In 1937 the Government-General designated Tsugitaka-Taroko National Park.
It covered about 270,000 hectares and lapsed with the end of Japanese rule.

zh: 1956年7月7日，中部橫貫公路動工。
路線的最高點，是海拔2565公尺的大禹嶺。
en: On 7 July 1956 construction of the Central Cross-Island Highway began.
Its highest point is Dayuling, at 2,565 m.

zh: 築路的主力是退除役官兵，多半靠人力與炸藥開山。
1960年5月9日，公路正式通車，取代了越嶺古道。
en: Most of the builders were veterans, working largely by hand and with explosives.
The highway opened on 9 May 1960 and replaced the old cross-ridge road.

zh: 長春祠，紀念築路期間殉職的兩百多位人員。
祠堂曾被山崩毀壞，重建後依舊守在瀑布上方。
en: The Eternal Spring Shrine honours more than two hundred people who died building the road.
Destroyed by landslides and rebuilt, it still stands above the waterfall.

zh: 祠名來自終年不斷的長春瀑布。
山壁、流水與祠堂，成為中橫公路上廣為人知的一景。
en: Its name comes from the Changchun Falls, which flow all year round.
Cliff, water and shrine form one of the highway's best-known views.

zh: 峽谷也曾被當作資源開發，立霧溪上築壩引水發電。
砂卡礑步道，原本就是興建發電廠時的施工道路。
en: The gorge was also developed as a resource: a dam on the Liwu diverts water for power.
The Shakadang Trail began as a construction road for a power plant.

zh: 1986年11月28日，太魯閣國家公園成立，面積約9.2萬公頃。
成立前後，立霧溪水力發電與崇德水泥開發計畫相繼喊停。
en: Taroko National Park was established on 28 November 1986, covering about 92,000 hectares.
Around that time a Liwu hydropower scheme and a cement project at Chongde were both halted.

zh: 布洛灣的山月吊橋，最早建於1914年。
現在的橋長196公尺，距溪面153公尺，2020年8月啟用。
en: The Shanyue suspension bridge at Buluowan was first built in 1914.
Today's bridge, 196 m long and 153 m above the river, opened in August 2020.

zh: 2001到2007年間，燕子口另闢新隧道，舊路成為景觀道路。
九曲洞的舊公路，也在1996年隧道通車後改為步道。
en: Between 2001 and 2007 a new tunnel was built at Yanzikou, and the old road became a scenic route.
At Jiuqudong the old highway became a walking trail after a bypass tunnel opened in 1996.

zh: 錐麓古道在2009年5月重新開放，進入前必須申請許可。
昔日的警備道，如今是需要預約的歷史步道。
en: The Zhuilu Old Road reopened in May 2009, and a permit is required to enter.
A former police road is now a historic trail that has to be booked.

zh: 2024年4月3日花蓮地震，重創園區的步道與中橫公路。
修復分區進行，各處陸續重新開放，實際情形以最新公告為準。
en: The Hualien earthquake of 3 April 2024 badly damaged the park's trails and the highway.
Repairs go area by area and sites reopen in stages; current notices give the actual status.

zh: 警備道、公路、國家公園，一層層歷史都刻在同一道峽谷裡。
路會中斷，也會再修通，峽谷的故事還在繼續。
en: Police road, highway, national park: each layer of history is cut into the same gorge.
Roads break and are mended again, and the gorge's story continues.

title.zh-Hant: 太魯閣族的家園與地名

tagline.zh-Hant: 立霧、布洛灣、塔比多：留在地名裡的族人記憶
tagline.en: Liwu, Buluowan, Tupido: memory kept in place names

zh: 太魯閣這個名字，來自世居此地的太魯閣族，Truku。
峽谷裡的地名，還記得多少族人的生活。
en: The name Taroko comes from the Truku people, whose home this has long been.
How much of their life do the gorge's place names still remember?

zh: 約兩百五十到三百年前，族人的祖先住在濁水溪上游。
他們翻越中央山脈，往東進入立霧溪流域。
en: Some 250 to 300 years ago their ancestors lived on the upper Zhuoshui River.
They crossed the Central Mountain Range eastward into the Liwu River basin.

zh: 遷徙的原因，可能是人口增加、耕地不足，或尋找新獵場。
沿著溪谷與河階，部落一處處建立起來。
en: Growing numbers, a shortage of farmland or the search for new hunting grounds may have moved them.
Village after village was founded along the valleys and river terraces.

zh: 天祥舊稱塔比多，在族語裡指的是山棕。
現在的地名，是後來為紀念文天祥而改的。
en: Tianxiang was once Tupido, a Truku name referring to a palm, the Arenga.
The present name came later, in memory of the Song-dynasty figure Wen Tianxiang.

zh: 國家公園範圍內，已發現79處舊部落遺址。
它們分布在立霧溪主流與支流的兩岸。
en: Seventy-nine former village sites have been identified within the national park.
They are spread along both banks of the Liwu River and its tributaries.

zh: 布洛灣這個地名，相傳是族語回音的意思。
臺地上設有太魯閣族文化的展示空間，重現傳統竹屋。
en: Buluowan is said to mean 'echo' in the Truku language.
On the terrace, exhibition spaces and rebuilt bamboo houses present Truku culture.

zh: 傳統衣料是自織的麻布，白底配上茶褐色條紋。
紡織、藤編等手工藝，做工精巧細緻。
en: Traditional cloth was home-woven: white, with tea-brown stripes.
Weaving, rattan work and other crafts are noted for their fine workmanship.

zh: 砂卡礑溪是立霧溪的支流，步道舊名神秘谷。
2001年，步道改用溪谷原有的地名：砂卡礑。
en: Shakadang Stream is a tributary of the Liwu; its trail was once called Mysterious Valley.
In 2001 the trail took the valley's own name: Shakadang.

zh: 步道途中的五間屋，曾是五戶族人的家。
砂卡礑溪流域，過去還有數個部落。
en: Wujianwu, 'Five Houses', on the trail was once the home of five Indigenous households.
The Shakadang valley once held several more villages.

zh: 峽谷口上方的山上，有大禮、大同兩個部落。
2004年起部落發展生態旅遊，訪客循步道上山。
en: On the heights above the gorge mouth are the villages of Dali and Datong.
Since 2004 they have developed eco-tourism, and visitors climb to them by trail.

zh: 立霧溪口附近的崇德，同樣是太魯閣族的聚落。
立霧這個名字，源自族語Tkijig，原指這條溪與這處聚落。
en: Chongde, near the river mouth, is also a Truku settlement.
'Liwu' goes back to the Truku word Tkijig, which named both the river and this settlement.

zh: 日治時期，這個詞被寫成日語讀音相近的漢字「立霧」。
一個族語的詞，就這樣留在今天的地圖上。
en: Under Japanese rule it was written with kanji read 'Takkiri', the origin of the name Liwu.
A Truku word has stayed on the map ever since.

zh: 1914年的太魯閣戰爭之後，日本當局推行集團移住。
山裡的族人被遷往今日的秀林、萬榮與卓溪。
en: After the Truku War of 1914, the Japanese authorities imposed group resettlement.
People from the mountain villages were moved to today's Xiulin, Wanrong and Zhuoxi.

zh: 秀林鄉面積約1642平方公里，是全臺面積最大的鄉。
鄉內居民多數是太魯閣族人。
en: Xiulin Township, about 1,642 square kilometres, is the largest township in Taiwan by area.
Most of its residents are Truku.

zh: 族人稱祖先傳下的規範為Gaya，約束行為與道德。
狩獵有固定的季節，四到六月是休獵期。
en: The rules handed down by the ancestors are called Gaya; they govern conduct and morals.
Hunting keeps to set seasons, and April to June is a closed period.

zh: 過去，族人被歸類為泰雅族的一支。
2004年1月，太魯閣族正名成功，成為臺灣第12個原住民族。
en: The Truku were long classified as a branch of the Atayal.
In January 2004 they gained recognition as Taiwan's twelfth Indigenous people.

zh: 2010年，國家公園與部落的共同管理會議首次召開。
如何讓族人實質參與這片土地的管理，至今仍是課題。
en: In 2010 the park's joint management committee with the communities met for the first time.
How Truku people can take a real part in managing this land remains an open question.

zh: Tkijig、布洛灣、塔比多，地名替這片土地記住了族人的足跡。
飛過峽谷，也是飛過太魯閣族人的家園。
en: Tkijig, Buluowan, Tupido: place names keep the Truku presence on this land.
To fly through the gorge is to fly through a Truku homeland.

tagline.zh-Hant: 一條溪谷串起的海拔落差與生命
tagline.en: Life along one valley's climb through the altitude zones

zh: 立霧溪口，海拔零公尺。
從這裡到園區最高的南湖大山，高差3742公尺，住著哪些生命。
en: The mouth of the Liwu River, at sea level.
From here to Nanhu Mountain, the park's highest summit, is 3,742 m. What lives in between?

zh: 園區從亞熱帶的海岸，延伸到寒帶氣候的高山。
已知的植物超過兩千種，動物超過一千五百種。
en: The park stretches from a subtropical coast to peaks with a frigid climate.
More than 2,000 plant species and over 1,500 animal species are known here.

zh: 低海拔的溪谷裡，闊葉林貼著大理岩壁生長。
砂卡礑溪水色清澈，沿途匯成一個個深潭。
en: In the low valleys, broadleaf forest clings to the marble walls.
Shakadang Stream runs clear, collecting in one deep pool after another.

zh: 燕子口岩壁上的孔洞，曾是燕子築巢的地方，地名由此而來。
遊客增多之後，燕子已不如從前常見。
en: Swallows once nested in the holes of the cliffs at Yanzikou, hence its name.
With more visitors, the birds are no longer as common as they were.

zh: 以太魯閣或園內地名命名的植物，共有63種。
其中22種，只生長在這座國家公園裡。
en: Sixty-three plant species are named after Taroko or places inside the park.
Twenty-two of them grow only within this national park.

zh: 峽谷的岩壁陡峭少土，植物只能長在岩縫與窄小的平臺上。
即使如此，岩壁上仍有稀有的峽谷植物。
en: The gorge walls are steep with little soil; plants hold on in cracks and on narrow ledges.
Even so, rare gorge plants grow on these cliffs.

zh: 天祥一帶的闊葉林裡，有太魯閣櫟與太魯閣大戟。
這裡也常有臺灣獼猴出沒，管理處提醒不接觸、不餵食。
en: The broadleaf forest around Tianxiang holds Taroko oak and Taroko spurge.
Formosan macaques are often seen here; the park asks people not to touch or feed them.

zh: 十三年的鳥類繫放調查，在園區記錄到213種鳥。
繫放也讓人得知，有鳥在這裡與西伯利亞之間遷徙。
en: Thirteen years of bird-banding surveys recorded 213 bird species in the park.
Banding has also shown that some birds travel between here and Siberia.

zh: 海拔約1180公尺的蓮花池，調查記錄到臺灣野山羊、山羌與藍腹鷴。
園區的蝙蝠共記錄到25種，被當作觀察氣候變遷的指標。
en: At Lianhua Pond, about 1,180 m up, surveys recorded Formosan serow, Reeves's muntjac and Swinhoe's pheasant.
Twenty-five bat species are known in the park and are followed as indicators of climate change.

zh: 沿著中橫公路往上，森林的樣貌隨海拔一段段改變。
闊葉樹漸漸讓位給針葉樹。
en: Up the highway, the forest changes character with each rise in altitude.
Broadleaf trees gradually give way to conifers.

zh: 園區長期研究臺灣水鹿。
2009年起，研究人員為水鹿戴上衛星定位頸圈，追蹤牠們的行蹤。
en: The park has long studied the Formosan sambar deer.
Since 2009 researchers have fitted sambar with GPS collars to follow their movements.

zh: 一部生態紀錄片在園區山林拍攝三年，拍到麝香貓與林鵰。
拍攝期間，團隊也遇見了黑熊。
en: An ecological documentary filmed here over three years captured a civet and the black eagle.
During the shoot the crew also met a black bear.

zh: 武嶺，海拔3275公尺，是臺灣公路的最高點。
到了這個高度，森林退去，稜線上是成片的高山草坡。
en: Wuling, 3,275 m, is the highest point on Taiwan's paved roads.
At this height the forest falls away, and grassy alpine slopes cover the ridges.

zh: 合歡山，園區最西側的高山區。
2007年起的三年間，管理處在這裡移植復育了36種高山植物。
en: Hehuanshan forms the high-mountain area at the park's far western edge.
Over three years from 2007, park staff transplanted 36 alpine plant species here for restoration.

zh: 往東看，立霧溪的源頭就在合歡山與奇萊北峰之間。
雨水從這裡出發，穿過所有海拔帶，流回海邊。
en: To the east, the Liwu River rises between Hehuanshan and Qilai North Peak.
Rain that falls here passes through every altitude zone on its way back to the sea.

zh: 回到海岸，清水斷崖的山壁從海面直接升起。
鳥類繫放調查的範圍，就從海平面一路涵蓋到三千公尺以上。
en: Back on the coast, the walls of the Qingshui Cliff rise straight from the sea.
The bird-banding survey spans this whole range, from sea level to above 3,000 m.

zh: 園區內原本劃有33處礦區，2008年起禁止採礦。
從溪口到稜線，每一段海拔都有各自的住民。
en: The park once contained 33 mining areas; mining has been banned since 2008.
From river mouth to ridgeline, every band of altitude has residents of its own.

title.en: The River That Cut Through Marble

tagline.zh-Hant: 從出海口溯到高山，看抬升與下切如何刻出峽谷
tagline.en: From river mouth to high peaks: how uplift and incision carved the gorge

zh: 花蓮縣秀林鄉，立霧溪在這裡流入太平洋。
一條55公里長的溪，如何切出一座大理岩峽谷。
en: Xiulin Township, Hualien County: here the Liwu River reaches the Pacific.
How did a river only 55 km long cut a gorge through solid marble?

zh: 流域面積約616平方公里，全都在秀林鄉境內。
源頭在三千公尺的高山，終點就是眼前的海。
en: Its basin covers about 616 square kilometres, all within Xiulin Township.
It starts some 3,000 m up in the high mountains and ends at this shore.

zh: 太魯閣口，寬闊的河床到這裡突然收窄。
再往西，兩岸的岩壁陡然立起。
en: At the gorge mouth the wide gravel bed suddenly narrows.
Further west, rock walls rise sharply on both banks.

zh: 岩壁的主角是大理岩，前身是兩億多年前淺海中的石灰岩。
深埋之後受熱受壓，才變質成今天的大理岩。
en: The walls are marble that began as limestone in a shallow sea over 200 million years ago.
Buried deep, heated and squeezed, it was transformed into the marble seen today.

zh: 約四百萬年前，菲律賓海板塊與歐亞板塊相撞。
碰撞把古老的岩層推擠抬高，中央山脈隨之隆起。
en: About four million years ago the Philippine Sea Plate collided with the Eurasian Plate.
The collision squeezed these old rocks upward as the Central Mountain Range rose.

zh: 布洛灣，峽谷中的一塊平坦臺地。
這一帶的地殼仍以每年約半公分的速度抬升。
en: Buluowan is a level terrace set inside the gorge.
The crust here is still rising, by roughly half a centimetre every year.

zh: 燕子口，整條峽谷最窄的地段之一。
抬升與下切同時進行，緻密的大理岩便留下近乎垂直的岩壁。
en: Yanzikou, the Swallow Grotto, is among the narrowest stretches of the whole gorge.
With uplift and downcutting at work together, the dense marble is left as near-vertical walls.

zh: 岩壁上成排的孔洞，是流水長期侵蝕大理岩的痕跡。
從正上方看，溪谷只剩一道細縫。
en: Rows of holes in the cliff were worn into the marble by water over a long time.
Seen from directly above, the valley is no more than a slit.

zh: 再往上游是九曲洞一帶，大理岩層的厚度估計超過一千公尺。
溪谷連續轉彎，公路只能鑽進岩壁裡。
en: Upstream lies Jiuqudong, where the marble is estimated to be over 1,000 m thick.
The river twists through bend after bend, and the road has to tunnel into the rock.

zh: 峽谷裡不只有大理岩，還有片岩與片麻岩。
這些變質岩，屬於臺灣目前已知最古老的岩層。
en: The gorge is not marble alone: there are schist and gneiss as well.
These metamorphic rocks are among the oldest known in Taiwan.

zh: 天祥，大沙溪與塔次基里溪在此匯流，合成立霧溪。
匯流處的河階，是深谷裡難得的平地。
en: At Tianxiang the Dasha and Tacijili streams meet to form the Liwu River.
The river terrace at their confluence is rare level ground in this deep valley.

zh: 往上游望去，山勢一路升高。
海拔兩千公尺以上的山區，約占園區的一半。
en: Looking upstream, the ridges climb steadily.
About half of the park lies above 2,000 m.

zh: 大禹嶺，中央山脈主稜上的隘口。
主稜是分水嶺，東側的立霧溪流域約占園區三分之二。
en: Dayuling is a pass on the main crest of the Central Mountain Range.
The crest is the divide; east of it, the Liwu basin makes up about two thirds of the park.

zh: 合歡山北峰，海拔3422公尺。
園區內名列臺灣百岳的高峰，共有27座。
en: Hehuanshan's North Peak rises to 3,422 m.
Twenty-seven of Taiwan's 'Hundred Peaks' lie within the park.

zh: 回到海邊。清水斷崖綿延約21公里，平均高度約800公尺。
大理岩與片麻岩構成的山壁，幾乎直接落入太平洋。
en: Back at the coast, the Qingshui Cliff runs for about 21 km and averages some 800 m in height.
Walls of marble and gneiss drop almost straight into the Pacific.

zh: 斷崖的最高點是清水山，海拔2408公尺。
山與海之間幾乎沒有平地，公路只能貼著崖壁前進。
en: The cliffs culminate in Mount Qingshui, 2,408 m.
With almost no flat land between mountain and sea, the highway clings to the cliff face.

zh: 陡峭的岩壁節理發達，原本就容易落石。
2024年4月3日花蓮地震後，燕子口一帶出現大規模崩塌。
en: These steep, heavily jointed walls have always shed rock.
After the Hualien earthquake of 3 April 2024, large collapses struck the Yanzikou area.

zh: 抬升、下切、崩落，這座峽谷至今仍在改變。
步道與公路的開放情形時有調整，以太魯閣國家公園管理處公告為準。
en: Uplift, incision, collapse: the gorge is still changing today.
Trail and road openings change; rely on notices from Taroko National Park Headquarters.
